sources.publication_cadence: Public SWR 32 query; electronically submitted applications since 2021-05-02; queried daily for the prior three calendar days
sources.retention: Official query row fields and stable filing/operator identity; detailed application and attachments are not fetched by this adapter
sources.collection_scope: Complete count-checked SWR 32 application result set for the prior three calendar days by submittal date, paged at 10 rows with a 50-page/500-record bound.
sources.coverage_limitation: Applications for exceptions only, not flaring/venting measurements. Rule 32 also permits some flaring without an exception application. Public query excludes pre-2021-05-02 online-system filings; older filings outside the three-day submittal window are not rechecked for status changes and no historical backfill is included. Application details and authorization documents are not fetched. Physical flare/vent site, requested volume, gas composition, continuous flow, generator fit, MW, rental demand, buyer, and buying authority remain UNKNOWN.

sources.publication_cadence: Continuously updated CKAN permit table; retrieved daily for the prior 90 calendar days by issued date
sources.retention: Official permit row fields, source row identifier, applicant label, amendment reference where explicit, issue date, current status, and official CKAN citation
sources.collection_scope: Bounded 90-day issued-permit window, all permit types/statuses; count-checked deterministic pagination ordered by issue timestamp and row ID.
sources.coverage_limitation: Not the full 664,565-row history. Closed/completed records remain evidence and are not admitted as current Signals. Applicant is not a buyer role. No construction start, project owner, temporary rental need, MW, supply gap, or authority is inferred; declared valuation and area are not power need. Status changes on records outside the recent issue window are not monitored.

sources.publication_cadence: Daily cumulative current-month file plus official previous-month end-of-month file

sources.collection_scope: All framed permit groups in current daf420.dat plus previous calendar month official end-of-month snapshot. One permit identity; lowest sequence is newest amendment. Older retained entities are never deleted by snapshot absence.
sources.coverage_limitation: Not all historical Texas permits. No pending-application feed or older-month correction monitoring. Outages longer than the prior-month overlap can miss activity. Current file over four days old, missing previous-month EOM, changed framing, or bounds fail visibly. Production date, load, fuel suitability, rental demand and contacts are UNKNOWN.

sources.coverage_limitation: As retrieved 2026-10-01, linked June-August 2026 workbooks contain 95 commercial rows / 89 unique Record IDs after six repeated IDs; issue dates span 2026-06-01 through 2026-08-28. Five use descriptions indicate residential occupancy despite the source Record Type being Commercial and are rejected by admission. Monthly publication lag leaves recent coverage incomplete. Does not cover all permits, alterations, or electrical permits, or prove current work, temporary-power need, load, rental demand, or authority.

sources.coverage_limitation: As retrieved 2026-10-01, four reports contain 1,543 rows (1,422 Building Pmt, 112 Demolition, 9 OCC-BLDG PMT). Latest link Sept 7-13 is 317 rows, workbook header reads From 2026/09/07 and To 2026/09/14, observed Permit Dates are 2026-09-08..13, and core metadata created/modified is 2026-09-14T16:43:22Z. The weekly range convention treats the To date as exclusive, though the workbook does not label it exclusive. On Oct 1 the latest sale date was 18 calendar days old and the report period end 17 days old. These internal dates do not verify publication time; source publication timestamp and lag are UNKNOWN. Weekly sheets have no party fields. Exact search detail returns role-specific Buyer, combined Owner/Occupant, buyer address and phone; person/company kind, phone ownership, current work and authority remain UNKNOWN. Not complete sold-permit history, electrical or commissioning coverage. Reports older than 30 days fail visibly; earlier revisions outside four reports are not monitored.
